> **Summary:** The server provides a MCP JSON‑RPC endpoint for accessing Musfiraai’s company data, services, FAQ, reviews, and contact methods. It includes health checks, build status tracking, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

**Keywords:** mcp-server · uptime-monitor · health-check · python · build-status

### FAQ

**What is the MCP endpoint?**  
The MCP endpoint is https://dark-spark-uxxux.run.mcp-use.com/mcp, accepting POST requests for JSON‑RPC calls.

**How do I run the server locally?**  
Install dependencies with pip install -r requirements.txt and run python server.py for stdio mode, or use MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http PORT=8000 python server.py for HTTP mode.

**How is build status tracked?**  
request_callback returns a request_id like MFA-4821; status is stored in a private repo and can be queried via GET /build-status?id=MFA-XXXX.

readme.preview:
<!-- AUTO-SEO:START -->
> **Summary:** The workflow pings the specified URLs every 10 minutes. If a ping fails, it opens a GitHub issue and keeps commenting until the server recovers, then closes the issue.

**Keywords:** github-actions · render · schedule · ping · alert · health-check · oracle-cloud · free-service

### FAQ

**How do I configure the URLs to ping?**  
Set the GitHub Actions variable TARGET_URLS to a comma- or space-separated list of URLs, e.g., TARGET_URLS=\"https://your-app.onrender.com\".

**What happens when the server recovers?**  
The workflow automatically closes the open issue and stops commenting once the ping succeeds again.

**Will this work with a Render free service?**  
Yes, the workflow pings every 10 minutes, which is frequent enough to wake a Render free service that sleeps after 15 minutes of inactivity.
